Harvey wallbanger: 3 parts vodka (I use 5), 1 pt Galliano -an anise liqueur, which is odd, because I hate all other anise liqueurs with a passion, and 6 parts OJ. It was the first drink I ordered at a proper bar, because I thought the name sounded neat, but to me, it tastes like orange marmalade.
Rusty nail, however, is courtesy of my brother-in-law. I have a cast-iron stomach, and liver, so I can drink a lot, even for a guy of my weight, and I can mix liquors and beer, which is a no-no for most people. Well, I have a tendency to not order the same drink twice, so while watching some game at the local bar with my family, they were running out of ideas of what they could order me to make me puke, and my BIL said rusty nail. They brought it out and I loved it. It's definitely not everybody's cup of tea booze, being its three parts scotch, two parts Drambuie (a scotch based liqueur), but the ratio is usually tweaked to taste, I go a bit sweeter, it's usually 2:1; but damn is it good, and two at the end of night work better than ambien.

I love the story behind your decision to try out the Harvey Wallbanger. It speaks to me, because sometimes it's just a creative name that draws you in. As far as the Rusty Nail, I've yet to have the pleasure, and it sounds like a fairly potent cocktail! I'll have to give 'er a try.
